title: CMO Ayodhya Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 11 Medical Officer Posts
description: Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Ayodhya (CMO Ayodhya), has issued the official notification for the recruitment of 11 Medical Officer Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS can grab this chance and apply for the CMO Ayodhya Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
